Analyze population and ancestry-specific genomic variation, genotype-phenotype relationships, disease associations, and clinically relevant genomic findings. Identify and investigate variants of uncertain significance (VUS), conflicting classifications, and genomic evidence gaps that warrant further study. Develop reproducible analytical workflows and integrate genomic evidence with clinical, phenotypic, epidemiological, functional, and published evidence.
